bio.text: Sheri Biggs was elected to the U.S. House of Representatives in 2024 and is the first woman to represent South Carolina's 3rd District.
She is a Lieutenant Colonel in the Air National Guard and has served as a medical crew director on missions supporting Operation Freedom's Sentinel.

Her background includes more than three decades in health care as a nurse, nursing home administrator and consultant, and she holds a Doctor of Nursing Practice from Samford University and a bachelor's degree from Carolina Bible College.
